description:
I'm Jeff Graves. Thirty-one years in the fire service, and these days I run a department.

Most house fires don't start with anything dramatic. They start with a cord under a rug, a charger under a pillow, a dryer running after everyone's gone to bed. I've walked through the aftermath of the ordinary stuff more times than I can count, and almost every one of those fires had a fix that takes about a minute.

That's what this channel is. No scare tactics. I'll tell you what's actually happening inside the thing that heats up, why it goes wrong, and the one-minute fix that stops it.

Stay safe out there.
